gloss: to conjecture; to guess; to surmise
notes:
A formal word for guessing or conjecturing based on limited evidence. Also an important grammatical term in Japanese: ⟦{推量|すいりょう}→推量：21807_suiryou⟧{形|けい} (conjectural form) refers to verb endings like だろう and でしょう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{推量|すいりょう}→推量：21807_suiryou⟧{形|けい}: conjectural form (grammar term)
- ～⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{推量|すいりょう}する: to surmise from ~
- ⟦{推量|すいりょう}→推量：21807_suiryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{域|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧: to not go beyond conjecture
- ⟦{推量|すいりょう}→推量：21807_suiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない: to be merely conjecture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{推測|すいそく}する→推測する：17957_suisokusuru⟧: to guess, to speculate — very close synonym; slightly more common in everyday usage
- ⟦{推察|すいさつ}する→推察する：25242_suisatsusuru⟧: to infer, to surmise — more formal; often implies sympathetic understanding
- ⟦{憶測|おくそく}→憶測：16398_okusoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to speculate — carries a negative nuance of unfounded speculation
- ⟦{見当|けんとう}→見当：02795_kentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to make a rough estimate — more casual

REGISTER:
Formal. More common in written language, academic discussions, and grammar terminology. In everyday speech, ⟦{推測|すいそく}→推測：12821_suisoku⟧ or simply ⟦{想像|そうぞう}→想像：02489_souzou⟧ are more natural.

definitions.gloss: to conjecture; to guess; to surmise
definitions.explanation: to form an opinion or estimate about something without having complete information; to make an inference or educated guess

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{推量|すいりょう}する。
examples.english: To guess the other person's feelings.
